summary: Server-side tag recovery that preserves valid Minecraft tag entries when a mod or datapack references missing entries.
lead: LMFT-recrafted prevents a missing required tag entry from causing Minecraft to discard an entire tag. Valid entries are retained, helping avoid broken gameplay when mods or datapacks reference unavailable content.
install: Install the Fabric JAR on Fabric or the NeoForge JAR on NeoForge, on the server or single-player host. Remote clients do not need LMFT-recrafted. Do not install the original LMFT alongside this fork because both use the lmft mod ID. Use the marketplace's file compatibility information to choose the correct version.
